scope: Related open-source metadata, pipeline, visualization and extraction projects; interface patterns, not installed engines.
implementation: Original code; no upstream source or artwork copied.

projects.name: DataHub
projects.pattern: Searchable metadata catalogues and upstream/downstream lineage.
projects.applied: Artifact lineage with selectable evidence nodes.
projects.limit: This is artifact lineage, not document-semantic lineage.

projects.name: OpenMetadata
projects.pattern: Asset context brings ownership, lineage and quality signals together.
projects.applied: Readiness states and gate details beside each project.
projects.limit: Quality states are qualitative, not an invented quality score.

projects.name: Marquez
projects.pattern: Dataset/job lineage graphs connect current and historical run metadata.
projects.applied: Clickable checkpoints with counts and acknowledgement states.
projects.limit: A static checkpoint projection; no Marquez server is installed.

projects.name: Apache NiFi
projects.pattern: A flow canvas displays processors, connections, queues and provenance.
projects.applied: Scanned-versus-pending queue bar and evidence flow.
projects.limit: The known queue can grow; it is not a full-corpus completion bar.

projects.name: Dagster
projects.pattern: Asset dependency graphs and integrated materialization observability.
projects.applied: Distinct source, inventory, checkpoint and register nodes.
projects.limit: Nodes describe saved artifacts, not executed hydrology models.

projects.name: Prefect
projects.pattern: Workflow activity and run states appear in its server dashboard.
projects.applied: Explicit ACK states and checkpoint details.
projects.limit: ACK describes register synchronization, not knowledge readiness.

projects.name: Apache Airflow
projects.pattern: Grid status heatmaps, dependency graphs and a run-history view.
projects.applied: A compact recent-checkpoint grid with click-to-inspect detail.
projects.limit: Only saved checkpoints are shown; these are not scheduled Airflow runs.

projects.name: Apache Superset
projects.pattern: Interactive charts, dashboards, filters and drill-to-detail.
projects.applied: A measure selector updates the growth chart and its count table together.
projects.limit: The selector is scoped to MSCH history; other measures keep their stated scopes.

projects.name: Docling
projects.pattern: Structured document representations preserve text, tables, pictures and layout.
projects.applied: Format roles and an explicit distinction between inventory and parsed content.
projects.limit: Page overlays and extracted-content previews are a later step; no parsed-page claim here.

projects.name: Docling Graph
projects.pattern: Interactive graphs use typed nodes, labelled relationships and provenance; exports include reports and statistics.
projects.applied: Selectable, explained artifact nodes plus downloadable chart data.
projects.limit: Semantic document graphs need validated content extraction first.
